appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.description: Light, dark or follow your system.
appearance.languageDescription: The language used for menus, buttons and messages.

languages.title: Languages
languages.description: Calls and practice can happen in many languages.

recording.title: Recording
recording.description: You are responsible for getting consent where recording laws require it.
recording.keepHint: When off, only transcripts and analyses are stored. You can change it per call.
recording.consentLineHint: Suggested as the first line of calls when a co-pilot has the consent line enabled.

yourData.title: Your data
yourData.private: Recordings, transcripts, scripts and agent configurations are private to your account.
yourData.delete: You can delete any recording, transcript or call from its page at any time. Deletion is permanent.
yourData.keepOnly: You can keep only transcripts and analyses by turning off recordings in Settings or per call.
yourData.sensitive: Sensitive information you provide (scripts, pricing, customer details) is only sent to the AI providers below to produce suggestions and analyses.

processors.title: Who processes your data
processors.description: Based on the models and voice providers you select.

consent.title: Recording consent
consent.text: Recording laws differ by country and region, and some require every participant's consent. Before recording a call, make sure you have it. Co-pilots can suggest your consent line as the first line of every call.

deleteAccount.title: Delete account
deleteAccount.description: Permanently deletes your account, co-pilots, prospects, calls, recordings and analyses.

deleteDialog.title: Delete your account permanently?
deleteDialog.description: All your data is removed immediately and can't be recovered.

usage.scopeOrg: Showing usage for everyone in this organisation.
usage.scopeMine: Showing your own usage in this organisation.

priceList.title: Price list
priceList.description: What each model and voice provider costs, so you can balance quality and spend.
